**Verdict: PASS** for DG1 round 13 (`T-DG1-REV-QA-R13`), on candidate `sha256:00f1498cd5e9a166db501452f699a3270ffca82455593fe9c0ab84a83e01c80b` (freeze `08cbd12`, 391 files).

The candidate ID recomputed identically in the working repo and in a full disposable clone. HEAD (`ed2160d`) is the freeze commit plus metadata only. During my run the runner added one auto-commit of the domain reviewer's files. I saw only their file names, and the candidate ID did not change.

**Findings I verified**
- **F-DG1-134 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** The module lint now checks every JS/TS file type in a module (`.mts`, `.cts`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs` as well as `.ts`/`.tsx`).
  - My own test plants files into the real module folder and runs the lint end to end. It passes 21/21 on Node 22 and on Node 24.
  - Run against the old round-12 lint, the same test fails 14 of 21. Those are exactly the non-`.ts`/`.tsx` cases, so it does catch the original bug.
  - The real module tree has 0 non-`.ts`/`.tsx` files and zero violations. The architecture tests pass 127/127 on both runtimes.
  - The change is test-only: between rounds 12 and 13 only `architecture.testkit.ts`, `architecture.test.ts` and `decisions.md` changed.
- **F-DG1-216 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** The assignment's grep on `decisions.md` finds nothing, and D-055 now says the route is "closed by rule 5", matching the lint's own header.
- **F-DG1-009, F-DG1-210 and F-DG1-214 still hold:**
  - F-DG1-009: no 57P01 errors or forced disconnects in three integration runs.
  - F-DG1-210: the Lead create → Edit/Archive journey passes without a reload in English and Arabic, plus in my separate test.
  - F-DG1-214: the web unit tests pass 110/110 on Node 24.

**Checks run (real output, evidence in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-13/`)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint (33 operations), no-CDN, formatting, contrast | All pass |
| Unit tests | 320/320 on Node 22 and on Node 24 |
| Integration on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.13 | 200/200 in each of 3 runs (Node 22 twice, Node 24 once) |
| Database migrations 0001–0008 | All applied |
| Audit log protection | UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are all rejected |
| API contract tests, including `getBrandingTokens` | 9/9 |
| Browser tests (English and Arabic) | 22/22 on Node 22 and on Node 24 |
| Accessibility scan (axe) | 0 violations |
| A12 / A13 / A14 | 14/14, 5/5, 5/5 |
| A18 clean start and A20 design tokens | Both pass |
| Validators `--register DG1`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile` | All pass |
| The 12 requirements | All marked implemented, with every cited evidence file present |

**BLOCKED:** one installer sub-check (AC-1 effect) couldn't run because it needs the npm registry and the sandbox has no network (`ECONNREFUSED`). The other 13 of 14 installer cases pass. The installer is unchanged since round 12, so its committed 14/14 log still applies.

**New findings:** none.
